# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure at Rosewood Bakery

**Report ID:** RB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 14, 2024
**Prepared by:** Operations Review Team, Rosewood Bakery
**Distribution:** Ownership, management team, posted for all staff

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 11:40 p.m. on March 13, 2024, the walk-in cooler at Rosewood Bakery lost power following a tripped breaker. The failure went undetected until the opening baker arrived at 4:15 a.m. on March 14. Over the course of roughly four and a half hours, interior temperatures rose from 38°F to 61°F, exceeding food safety thresholds for approximately three hours. As a result, the bakery discarded all temperature-sensitive inventory (approximately $2,300 in ingredients and finished goods), suspended cold-item sales for the morning, and operated on a reduced menu until a replacement shipment arrived at 11:00 a.m.

No customers were affected. No unsafe product was sold. This report reconstructs the timeline, examines contributing factors, and recommends changes to prevent recurrence.
